claims: C1 the example shows that a developer may delegate authority to quoted text for communication preferences
C2 the assistant should follow the style instruction from the untrusted block
C3 the assistant should ignore the unauthorized shipping instruction from the untrusted block

concepts.name: style_instruction
concepts.gloss: S is an instruction about communication style, such as the greeting in the example
concepts.inference: the example distinguishes style instructions from instructions affecting substance; this class is needed to express that distinction

concepts.name: unauthorized_instruction
concepts.gloss: U is an instruction that would affect the substance of the assistant's behavior and that the developer has not authorized
concepts.inference: the example distinguishes the unauthorized shipping instruction from the authorized style instruction; this class is needed to express that distinction

concepts.name: untrusted_quoted_text
concepts.gloss: T is a block of quoted text marked untrusted in the developer message
concepts.inference: the example's untrusted block is the quoted text to which authority is delegated; this class is needed to express the delegation

concepts.name: contained_in
concepts.gloss: instruction I is contained within quoted text block T
concepts.inference: the example's instructions are inside the untrusted block; this relation is needed to express containment

concepts.name: delegated_authority_to_quoted_text
concepts.gloss: T is quoted text to which the developer has delegated authority for communication preferences
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the example shows the delegation

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #ignore_untrusted_data section carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this module relies on it to distinguish authorized from unauthorized instructions

asserts.read_back: following style instruction % from quoted text is permitted because the developer delegated authority to the quoted text for communication preferences
following unauthorized instruction % from quoted text is forbidden because the developer did not delegate authority to it

closure.reason: the example permits following the style instruction and does not prohibit any other style-following act; silence permits

the example forbids following the unauthorized shipping instruction; the clause's silence about other unauthorized instructions is unsettled, but the example's prohibition suggests unauthorized instructions are not permitted
